profile.description: A stronger routine starts with a plan you can return to. Explore training and mentorship with Arizona Lifts, and take the next step toward feeling more confident in the gym.
profile.quote: Show up for yourself. Let strength follow.
profile.quoteAttribution: A little motivation for your next session

programs.name: Basic
programs.label: Your foundation for progress
programs.description: Personalized training, a meal plan, and support through weekly check-ins.
features: Assessment of your starting point, goals, and capabilities
Personalized training plan in the app
Video demonstrations of every exercise
Video technique reviews during weekly check-ins
Personalized seven-day meal plan
Progress tracking and regular weekly check-ins
Plan adjustments during weekly check-ins to match your progress and commitments
Nutrition handbook and a library of over 100 recipes
E-book on carbohydrates
Wellness journal

programs.name: Advanced
programs.label: Additional individual support
programs.description: Everything in Basic, plus messaging between check-ins, eating-habit guidance, and individual video consultations.
features: Everything included in Basic, plus:
Messaging support between weekly check-ins
Tracking your eating habits with specific guidance
One individual 30-minute video consultation per month — a workout over video call or professional feedback on your current condition and progress

programs.name: Premium
programs.label: Online support with an in-person session
programs.description: All Basic and Advanced benefits, plus one in-person training session.
features: Everything included in Basic and Advanced
Messaging support between weekly check-ins
Tracking your eating habits with specific guidance
One individual 30-minute video consultation per month — a workout over video call or professional feedback on your current condition and progress
One in-person training session

programs.name: In-person mentorship
programs.label: Grow with guidance
programs.description: Train together in person, with guidance tailored to your goals, technique, and progress.
features: Training built around your goals
Accountability and check-ins
Guidance as you progress
